narrative.overview: The page feels like a boutique selection studio: warm cream paper, white sheets laid on top of it, a high-contrast serif that speaks with authority, and a single terracotta signature that marks what matters. Everything is squared off and precise, like a tailored dossier handed to an experienced professional. It never reads like a mass job board. The LP takes the parent site's palette (terracotta and the house logo) but deliberately keeps its own voice. The serif and the boxed cards set it apart from the main zelore.it site, whose type is a geometric sans and which uses pill buttons and a fixed terracotta side rail. That distinction is intentional, not drift.
keyCharacteristics: Cream page (#f7f2ec), with white cards and a light shadow layered on top.
Playfair Display for every headline, numeral and card title; Inter for everything else.
One accent colour, terracotta: the light tone fills CTAs, and a deeper tone of the same hue colours highlighted words and numbers.
Square corners everywhere; the only circles are founder portraits.
Spaced uppercase only for small functional text (nav, buttons, form labels, the stats panel caption), never as an eyebrow above a heading.

rules.name: The One Signature Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only chromatic accent. A second hue (blue, green, a brighter orange) never enters the page. Within a section, terracotta marks at most one word of the headline plus the CTA.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Text on a terracotta fill is always ink (near-black), never white. White on #d09f79 fails contrast.

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: The light terracotta (#d09f79) is a fill and stroke colour, never a text colour on light backgrounds. Large accent text (headline highlights, numerals) uses terracotta-text; small accent text (anything under 24px regular or 18.66px bold) uses accent-ink. Light terracotta text is allowed only on the dark footer.

rules.name: The Serif-Speaks Rule
rules.body: Anything that makes a claim (headline, number, card title, quote) is set in Playfair. Anything that explains or labels is set in Inter.

rules.name: The Spaced Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase only appears small (≤13px) and always tracked (≥0.1em). Never set uppercase Playfair.

rules.name: The Paper Not Plastic Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and warm-tinted (rgba of 20,20,20 or 29,27,25), with blur ≥30px and opacity ≤10%. No tight drop shadows and no coloured glows on components.

rules.name: The Tailored Corner Rule
rules.body: Every container is squared off. A rounded button or card would read as the parent site's pill language and break the LP's distinct tone.

dos: Do set every headline, numeral and card title in Playfair Display (700/900), and all supporting copy in Inter.
Do highlight one word or clause per headline in terracotta-text (#a86f42), and keep the rest in ink.
Do put ink (#141414) text on terracotta fills.
Do use accent-ink (#6b4423) for small accent text such as roles, the "Da Zelo" tags and the focus ring.
Do keep corners square and lift white cards off cream with the shadow vocabulary above.
Do alternate page and cream bands between sections.
Do let headings stand alone: no eyebrow label above a section heading.
donts: Don't round buttons or cards. Pills belong to the parent site; the LP is squared off by design.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or use gradients on components.
Don't set any text in the light terracotta (#d09f79) on cream or white; it is 2.1–2.4:1. Use terracotta-text for large text and accent-ink for small text.
Don't use hard or dark shadows. Blur stays ≥30px and opacity ≤10%.
Don't set uppercase in Playfair, or set untracked uppercase.
